chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, forbade bargaining between the rising of dawn and the rising of the sun.

key_terms.السَّوْمِ: bargaining or engaging in trade negotiation
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: the rising of the sun; the end of the specified time period
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rising of dawn; the beginning of the specified time period
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition or forbiddance

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on bargaining between dawn and sunrise in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade bargaining during the period between the break of dawn and sunrise. It indicates a legal discouragement or prohibition related to commercial activity at this specific time.
